raw_lines.description: FJSP raw file content. The first line is num_jobs num_machines metadata, followed by one job row per job. The third header value is currently unused.

additional_lines.description: FJSP additional-information file content: processing energy rows, job feature rows, transport-time matrix and transport-energy matrix.

instance_name.description: Optional display name. It is sanitized before use.

num_samples.description: Number of stochastic DRL-S trajectories to sample. The best feasible sample is returned.

seed.description: Random seed used for reproducible sampling.
